QuestInfo.name: Greenery
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Olive to see who you should deliver the tools to next.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver a tool box to Sugar at Maple Tree Hill.
QuestInfo.2: You have delivered some seeds to Sugar at Maple Tree Hill.

0.0: Oh my ears! Tess's hammering is so freakin' loud!
0.1: Hey, #ho#. I think we've got it covered here. Why don't you bring the rest of the tools to Sugar up on Maple Tree Hill?

yes.0: Sugar seems kind of depressed. Maybe you can cheer her up.

no.0: You want to watch? You think hammerin' is funny, 'cause I sure do.

1.1: You brought me some tools? I don't need any-- OH! Some seeds from Henesys? Wonderful! I can plant them.

yes.0: Thanks, #h0#. I know this doesn't fix everything, but it's nice to know that some green will grow back, even if takes a while.

npc.0: I know you want to watch, but Sugar is waitin' for you.

item.0: Huh? You brought a tool box? Where?
